items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Dorsey I was with in ’47 and ’48

ctx.x: Louie Bellson? With his own big band?

No I never worked with Louie’s big band. I never worked with him there. Dorsey I was with in ’47 and ’48, and then ’49 I came out and starred for a year with the rest of the Kenton guys. They couldn’t get into the studios either for the first year or so. I mean I came in with a reputation as being a bop pianist, and being an arranger earlier, I used to play my saxophone parts on piano to hear what they sounded like, so I learned to play that blocked thing, legato, that George does. And Shearing at that time was…
